name: server-keys

metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which only cover this project's own files. `custody-import-rule.test.ts` lints sample imports with the workspace ESLint configuration, so a change to `eslint.config.mjs` or to ESLint itself must re-run it. Setting `inputs` REPLACES the inferred array, so the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared, with `eslint` added to the external dependencies.

test-integration.description: Run the Docker-backed key creation tests against the migrated schema (testcontainers Postgres). Requires a running Docker daemon.
